text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'SH minus N (top) and SH minus G (bottom). Dot: estimate. Line: 98.33% interval from resampling whole calendar months; the cold-snap interval is degenerate because those days fall in few months. Winter is November to March; a winter loss is a reason to hold the library back.'
text.tspan: SH minus N (top) and SH minus G (bottom). Dot: estimate. Line: 98.33% interval from resampling
whole calendar months; the cold-snap interval is degenerate because those days fall in few
months. Winter is November to March; a winter loss is a reason to hold the library back.
